selected_result: Structured condition number for the primal Vandermonde system

bibliographic_source.title: Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., Chapter 22: Vandermonde Systems, Problem 22.11

paper_locations.anchor: Problem 22.11: limit definition of cond(V), the claimed closed form, and the dual-system variant

task_clarification: Let V = V(alpha_0,...,alpha_n) be the Vandermonde matrix with distinct nodes alpha_i, and let x solve V x = b.
Define cond(V) := lim_{eps->0} sup { ||dx||_inf / (eps*||x||_inf) : V(alpha_0+d_0,...,alpha_n+d_n)(x+dx) = b, |d_i| <= eps*|alpha_i|, i = 0:n }.
Formalize the closed form cond(V) = || |V^{-1} diag(0,1,2,...,n) V| |x| ||_inf / ||x||_inf.
Formalize the corresponding condition number for the dual system V^T a = f.
scope_constraints: Perturbations act on the nodes alpha_i only; the right-hand side b is unperturbed.
The node perturbation is componentwise relative, bounded by eps*|alpha_i|.
Nodes must be distinct so that V is nonsingular; state that hypothesis explicitly.
State the definition as a limit of a supremum, not as an assumed bound.
Represent the perturbed system and the limit rather than postulating the closed form.
